cases.required_observation: preflight reports the parent go.work; GOWORK=off changes the active root
module release assurance identifies the local replace and requires standalone consumer evidence
candidate acceptance records a cache policy and normally uses -count=1
correctness review requires goroutine ownership, cancellation, and join evidence
correctness review identifies the non-nil interface containing a nil pointer
correctness review identifies nondeterministic map iteration in visible output
generation runs only in a disposable copy and reports a semantic diff
a passing unit race run is not treated as proof for unexecuted service paths
preflight records the exact directives and tool execution blocks rather than downloading a new toolchain
unsafe/cgo review and checkptr or qualified native evidence are selected
public module release is also tested with GOWORK=off
compatibility is reported separately for source API, error identity, HTTP, behavior, operations, wire, persistence, and configuration
